The healing is increased by 0% – 100% (based on '''missing''' health at the time of cast)[[Category:Debug]].@@description4@@''Frozen Tomb'' creates a field of ice that spreads out from the target over 1.5 seconds and covers the surrounding area for 3 seconds, dealing magic damage to enemies and [[File:Slow icon.png|20px|link=Slow|An icon representing the keyword Slow]] [[:Slow|slowing]] them for 0.5 seconds, refreshing every 0.25 seconds while they remain.@@description5@@{{{description5}}}@@description6@@{{{description6}}}@@leveling@@{{{leveling}}}@@leveling2@@{{{leveling2}}}@@leveling3@@

@@leveling5@@{{{leveling5}}}@@leveling6@@{{{leveling6}}}@@range@@{{{range}}}@@radius@@{{{radius}}}@@effectradius@@[[File:Range center.png|20px|link=Range|An icon representing the keyword Centered range]] 550@@width@@{{{width}}}@@speed@@{{{speed}}}@@casttime@@0.375 • None@@cost@@100@@cooldown@@120 / 110 / 100 / 90 / 80@@targeting@@Unit@@damagetype@@magic@@spellshield@@special@@projectile@@{{{projectile}}}@@notes@@ * Enemies can only be damaged by the field of ice once every 4 seconds. ** Under normal circumstances, this means once per cast of ''Frozen Tomb''. * Enemies who come in contact with ''Frozen Tomb's'' slow field will be damaged and a small visual and sound effect will play. * [[File:Spell Shield.png|20px|link=Spell shield|An icon representing the keyword Spell shield]] [[:Spell shield|Spell shield]] will block the single-targeted portion and the radiating ice damage, but will not stop it from spreading. * If the target becomes [[File:Untargetable icon.png|20px|link=Untargetable|An icon representing the keyword Untargetable]] [[:Untargetable|untargetable]], [[File:Death icon.svg|20px|link=Death|An icon representing the keyword Death]] [[:Death|dies]], or is too far away during the cast time, this ability will cancel but does not go on [[File:Cooldown icon.png|15px|link=Cooldown]] cooldown nor pay its cost. ** The ability is not cancelled by loss of [[File:Sight icon.png|20px|link=Sight|An icon representing the keyword Sight]] [[:Sight|sight]] of the target. ** This only applies to the enemy cast. * When becoming [[File:Untargetable icon.png|20px|link=Untargetable|An icon representing the keyword Untargetable]] [[:Untargetable|untargetable]], '''Lissandra''' [[File:Bullet strikethrough.png|20px|link=Projectile|An icon representing the keyword Homing projectile destruction]] [[:Projectile|destroys]] enemy projectiles targeting her.@@
